newsitem.title: JAPAN: Foreigners net sellers of Japanese stocks in week.
newsitem.headline: Foreigners net sellers of Japanese stocks in week.

text.p: Foreigners were net sellers of Japanese stocks on the Tokyo, Osaka and Nagoya stock exchanges in the week of November 5 to November 8, exchange data showed.
Foreigners have been net sellers for the past five weeks after buying continuously for the previous five weeks, according to the data.
The figures, which are rounded, are as follows:
Previous week net selling 87.46 billion yen
